== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Vader's Mask]] (Virtual Block 7.1), showing the '''original''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Vader's Mask (Errata)]] (PC-E1).

* '''Text source:''' Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet, first printing (official text as of 18 June 2010; not preserved): the re-made sheet's text (copy re-made 28 July 2010, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]) before the Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications" of 28 June 2010 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025225/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:some-minor-errors-and-clarifications&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]).
* '''Original text:''' “Deploy on [Vader] Vader. During your battle phase, may cancel this Effect to allow Vader to make a regular move. In order for opponent's character to move away from here, opponent must first lose 1 Force. While defending a battle at opponent's site, Vader is power +2 and immune to attrition. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L6731</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_277</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the original game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. CardMaker cannot draw the round [Vader] icon printed left of the text box; the inline [Vader] icon is CardMaker's square Vader icon.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
